svg.title: Public key against signature, every scheme measured
svg.desc: Log-log plot of public key size against signature size. Classical schemes sit in the bottom left corner, under 300 bytes each. ML-DSA sits near 1.3 to 2.6 KB keys and 2.4 to 4.6 KB signatures; Falcon is smaller. SLH-DSA has 32-byte keys and 7.8 to 17 KB signatures. UOV has tiny 96 to 128-byte signatures and 43 to 412 KB keys. MAYO and SNOVA sit in between.

text.tspan: public key (travels in certificates, or sits in the client)
